name: Elizabeth
beschreibung:
The family-run Pension Elizabeth in Soelden stands out with its convenient location and welcoming atmosphere. Lovingly appointed rooms ensure every comfort needed after active days amidst the Oetztal Alps.

Cable car base stations, ski bus stops, shops, and restaurants are just moments away. An ideal home base for skiers, snowboarders, hikers, and mountain bikers.
kurzbeschreibung: Pension Elizabeth in Soelden provides comfortable rooms and central relaxation for winter sports lovers in the Oetztal.
